- Instead, we can move down to [40, 4] to avoid the barrier.
- Then, we can move left to [39, 4].
- Next, we can move up to [39, 20] (avoiding the vertical barriers).
- Finally, we can move left to [40, 20].

- Start at [45, 5]
- Move to [40, 5]
- Move down to [40, 4]
- Move left to [39, 4]
- Move up to [39, 20]
- Move left to [40, 20]
